svg.text: PostgreSQL source of truth, 3NF, 7 tables (crow's foot notation)

g.text: CHECK status IN (pending, processing, shipped, delivered)

svg.text: • orders M : N products is resolved by order_items; unit_price is the price at purchase time.
• order_items, payments, order_status_history reference orders ON DELETE CASCADE.
• Triggers: order total = SUM(quantity x unit_price); every status change is logged in order_status_history.
• All tables use REPLICA IDENTITY FULL so Debezium CDC events carry the full before/after row.
